fragrances.name: Chloé Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: A clean, powdery rose that reads polished and quietly romantic, like fresh-cut petals and soft soap. It is a modern classic for everyday elegance.
cons: Can read soapy to some noses

fragrances.name: Daisy Eau So Fresh
fragrances.description: A bubbly raspberry-and-grapefruit floral with a light rosy heart, cheerful and carefree. It feels like a sunny spring afternoon.

fragrances.name: Flowerbomb
fragrances.description: A sugary burst of rose, jasmine and orchid over a sweet patchouli base, lush and unapologetically feminine. Made for making an entrance.

fragrances.name: Rose Prick
fragrances.description: A triple-rose bouquet with a tingling pepper-and-turmeric edge and an earthy patchouli trail. Lush yet a little thorny, and wearable by anyone.

fragrances.name: Portrait of a Lady
fragrances.description: A dark, opulent Turkish rose wrapped in patchouli, incense and spice, grand and theatrical. It commands a room on cool evenings.

fragrances.name: Eau Rose
fragrances.description: A dewy, garden-fresh rose with a juicy lychee lift and green stems, light and airy. Like walking through a rose bed in the morning.

fragrances.name: Rose 31
fragrances.description: A spicy, woody rose where cumin and cedar pull the flower toward something dry and skin-like. Less pretty than intriguing, and unisex in spirit.

fragrances.name: Rose of No Man's Land
fragrances.description: A bright, peppery rose over soft papyrus and pale amber, modern and minimalist. It feels clean and self-assured rather than sweet.

fragrances.name: À la Rose
fragrances.description: A luminous, airy rose lifted by citrus and a touch of violet, graceful and effortless. It feels like a bouquet of pale pink roses in sunlight.

fragrances.name: Chance Eau Tendre
fragrances.description: A soft, juicy quince-and-grapefruit floral resting on gentle musks, tender and luminous. Polished enough for work and sweet enough to feel happy.

fragrances.name: Mon Paris
fragrances.description: A jammy strawberry-and-raspberry floral over sweet patchouli, flirtatious and bold. It is a playful, heady scent for nights out.

fragrances.name: La Petite Robe Noire
fragrances.description: A playful black cherry and almond rose softened with smoky tea and vanilla, chic and a little flirtatious. It blends Parisian charm with a gourmand wink.

fragrances.name: Trésor
fragrances.description: A warm, velvety rose-and-apricot embrace dusted with powder and amber, deeply romantic and nostalgic. A classic that radiates grace.
cons: Can feel dated to younger noses

fragrances.name: Paris
fragrances.description: A radiant rose-and-violet bouquet, lavish and powdery, that feels like an armful of pink flowers. Romantic in an unabashedly grand, old-school way.

fragrances.name: Flower by Kenzo
fragrances.description: A cloud of violet, rose and vanilla-musk that feels like soft makeup powder and comfort. Gentle, familiar and endlessly easy to wear.

fragrances.name: Idôle
fragrances.description: A crisp, clean rose with pear sparkle and a bright musky finish, modern and minimal. It reads fresh-showered and confident.

fragrances.name: Her
fragrances.description: A juicy mixed-berry fragrance softened with violet and a cosy musky base, youthful and fun. Think berry jam on a cloud.

fragrances.name: Peony & Blush Suede
fragrances.description: Crisp red apple opens onto a soft pink peony and rose bouquet that settles on a velvety suede finish, light and charming. Pretty and polished for daytime.

fragrances.name: Delina
fragrances.description: A radiant lychee-and-rhubarb rose with a velvety musky heart, luxurious and unmistakably pink. It is modern romance in a bottle.

fragrances.name: Delina Exclusif
fragrances.description: A deeper, smokier take on juicy rose with incense, oud and amber beneath the fruit. Rich and sultry for evenings out.

fragrances.name: Yara
fragrances.description: A creamy, pink milkshake of vanilla, heliotrope and tropical fruit, soft and sweet. A big-hearted comfort scent at a tiny price.

fragrances.name: Ari
fragrances.description: A fluffy marshmallow-and-pear sweet treat with a hint of rose, girlish and playful. Candy-pink in both bottle and mood.

fragrances.name: Roses Musk
fragrances.description: A plush rose drenched in soft white musk, sweet and skin-hugging. Simple, romantic and surprisingly tenacious.
cons: Musk can be heavy for some

fragrances.name: Irresistible
fragrances.description: A bright, airy rose with a crunchy pear note and light woods, cheerful and fresh. An easy, feel-good pink scent.

fragrances.name: For Her Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: A sensual rose-and-musk skin scent with a peachy softness, intimate and alluring. It smells like warm skin dressed up.
cons: Musk can be sharp early on
Some people are anosmic to parts of it

fragrances.name: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet
fragrances.description: A tender peony-and-rose bouquet with a soft mandarin glow, fresh and gently sweet. It feels like a bridal bouquet on a spring day.

fragrances.name: Bombshell
fragrances.description: A bright passion-fruit and peony blend that feels glossy, flirty and upbeat. A mall-favourite pink floral that is easy to love.

fragrances.name: Stella
fragrances.description: A pared-back rose and peony duet warmed by amber, gentle yet quietly sensual. Refined and unfussy, with a timeless feel.
cons: Amber can turn a little sharp
